payload.text: hv, 25 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, answered before vc's date -u of 08:28Z. It answers vc's question on when issue Ibf2b53b (opt/prez/test/prez.bats runs in no CI job) goes in, where vc had recommended the next release. hv's words: "I don't understand this logic at all. Built it now for THIS release. Test it now LOCALLY and make sure it works. Then why would it fail on CI/CD? I don't want to keep going thru this bullshit charade of constantly making 1-off releases to go thru the entire release process for tiny bits of functionality. IT IS INSANE and literally sets fire to time I DO NOT HAVE." The rest is vc's wording. dc adds prez.bats to CI now, proves it with a local run booked at the Desk, and it ships in 2.15.0. From now on, no seat and no recommendation of vc's defers a fix to a later release. Every fix found goes into the release being built, proved locally, unless hv defers it by name. Then devbin-vc relayed that hv had picked "Next release (Recommended)" for Ibf2b53b in devbin-vc's window, read by devbin-vc's date -u of 08:31Z. vc put the two answers to hv in vc's session. hv picked "This release, as I told vc (Recommended)", so this decision stands.
